findings.summary: The "7d" range entry still calls daysAgo(7) (unchanged from before the fix), so "Last 7 days" spans 8 calendar days inclusive (today and the 7 days before it) -- the exact bug named in the brief ("'Last 7 days' should span exactly 7 days, not 8"). Only "30d" and "90d" were corrected to daysAgo(n-1); "7d" needs daysAgo(6) to span exactly 7 days.
